correctness.rationale: PASS: For N=2^k and C={(x,x³)}, write s=x+y. The exact identity x³+(s−x)³=s³−3s x(s−x) gives two Hensel-lift solutions for each odd t when s odd; s=0 contributes r(0,0)=N. For nonzero even s=2^v u, choosing 2h=s reduces to t−2h³=3s(x−h)², so each target fiber equals 2^v times square-root count rho_{k−v}. The standard unit-square classification yields B_m=∑rho_m²=m·2^m by the recurrence B_m=2^(m+1)+4B_{m−2}; square-image counts Q_m yield the two parity cases for support. Summation gives E=N²(k²−k+8)/4 and |C+C|=(5N²+13N−10)/18 for odd k, or (5N²+14N−10)/18 for even k. Character orthogonality proves normalized fourth moment. Independently exhaustively enumerated all pairs k=1..8 with exact matches; no inference from finite range.
